profile.headline: North American SRE Squad Lead - IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Lead for North American SRE Squad - Cloud Foundation Services
positions.description: Lead a team of talented individuals across North America charged with maintaining the health of IBM's Cloud infrastructure.  Troubleshoot and resolve any issues that could threaten the stability of our Cloud offering.  Develop and deploy automated monitoring solutions for alerting my team of potential problems.  Interface with the global team to coordinate efforts across the World to maintain a 24/7 production environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Site Reliability Engineer for IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service.  In charge of developing automation, handling customer situations and trying to maintain order among the chaos.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - AIX (UNIX) Development Support
positions.description:
Work with IBM Partners (Oracle, Symantec, NetApp, HP, SAP, etc.) to identify and solve problems developing their applications on the AIX operating system. Lead the debugging and resolution of customer-found problems with such applications.  
Lead problem determination of customer-found bugs in complex and integrated systems running enterprise application software. Consistently able to quickly pinpoint the source of the problem down to the line of code, resulting in minimal customer downtime and 
Known for ability to build strong relationships with wide range of IBM Partners from account reps, technical contributors, managers and executives. This enabled an effective approach to solving customer problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Linux Technology Center
positions.description:
Lead team of software developers creating and maintaining Linux Performance tools.  Drove performance improvements into Java, WebSphere and the Linux kernel code in order to achieve leadership standings. 
Performance of IBM’s Linux servers as they entered the market was non-competitive and analysis tools were lacking. Led a team of developers creating several kernel performance tools that measured function such as lock and cpu utilization, polling performance counters and kernel program flow. These tools enabled analysis and tuning of these servers, improving performance of IBM’s Linux. 
WebSphere and Java applications were still in heavy development  and were not competitive.  I was able to drive analysis on integrated systems consisting of database back end, middle ware servers and front end  HTTP servers running Linux on Power and x86 processors.  Drove Java and WebSphere performance analysis and improvements on Linux on Power servers to competitive levels of performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer - AIX Development Java Performance
positions.description:
Responsible for improving performance of AIX Power systems running Enterprise business configurations.  Drove enhancements into Unix kernel and IBM's Java in order to achieve industry leadership standings.
Upon entry into the marketplace IBM's WebSphere on Unix's performance was lagging behind other competitors offerings.  I worked to establish a standardized performance benchmark to be used specifically for Enterprise Software systems.  With this standardization I was able to improve WebSphere performance on Unix systems an industry lead position.
The IBM Partner responsible for developing the 2000 Summer Olympics database and network software experienced many challenges in meeting their aggressive production schedule.  I was asked to join a group of Spanish speaking troubleshooters sent on site in Madrid to assist in driving improvements into the IBM Partner's development cycle.  Because of my teams' intervention, the IBM Partner was able to meet all deliverables on time.
A need arose to study and analyze “real world” integrated systems solutions and publish white papers for marketing to use in order to push sales of the Power Server product line.  Worked with my team to architect and deploy large integrated systems for our study.  These white papers were instrumental in driving sales of IBM's Power systems and cementing customer confidence in IBM's new Virtualization technology.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Served as Research assistant for the STESCA project headed by my Professor.  Developed the path planning algorithms for an autonomous robotic underwater vehicle.  Integrated AI components into the program and presented many papers on the subject.
